content: Viral loop patterns: Calendly-style loop where only the sender needs an account, the non-user experiences the product on click, and the signup path is offered right after the value moment; Loom-style branded artifact; loops must be built into the core action rather than added as an invite feature. Claude's own share-with-specific-people invites are bound to the invited email, expire after 30 days if unopened, and are subject to a daily invitation limit. Mostly growth blogs; single-source numbers unverified.
